entities.name: PMID:25075793
observations: Study assessed dynamic English narrative ability in 54 Spanish-English children, including 18 with language impairment and matched comparison groups.

Exploratory discriminant models combining modifiability ratings, narrative story scores, and posttest ungrammaticality classified participants with 80.6%–97.2% accuracy across measure combinations; sensitivity and specificity were not reported in the retrieved abstract.

entities.name: English narrative DA classification
observations: In a 54-child Spanish-English sample, exploratory combinations of dynamic-assessment ratings and narrative outcomes classified LI status with 80.6%–97.2% accuracy; sensitivity and specificity were not provided in the retrieved abstract.
Small, selected sample and exploratory discriminant analysis limit generalization; these results suggest promising, but not conclusive, diagnostic accuracy.
